properties.description:
A one-fix patch increment: the default tracing filter stops letting a dependency's info-level bookkeeping dominate reflow2's log, and the image says to cap the log it writes.

Pinned here because a release needs a position on the time axis. Without AT_EPOCH a release resolves to a point with no sequence, so any window computed from it loses its lower bound and silently widens to the beginning of the design.
properties.name: v0.55.1 cut — a dependency stops dominating the log stream
